additional_info.subject: ID0396999-DC/Si-D/DE[170001157] - No connection to backend CRM:00315002211
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
Mr. Ralph Lidner from Breilmann AG raised this ticket where they cannot charge since OCPP is offline. I am not able to access the charger remotely since after the update there was no SSH access request. As such, since it's holiday season, there will be a huge delay in providing this access.
The customer requested fast support. From my side, I believe there is something wrong with the config or SIM card, since we can see the router IP on the network. I suspect the error SIM not inserted or similar.
Please go to site and bring a spare router with you in case we need to replace it. Since it's in 5.0.21 there is no need to configure the router previously. You just need to plug the router and wait for the config to run.
Please reach out to me whoever gets assigned this ticket so that if I get SSH access we can align together the next steps.
